issue_request: FHIR-34476 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to support _include for Task input/output references by adding an input search parameter: code input, type reference, expression Task.input.value.ofType(Reference).
initial_application: The issue was already applied. Jira cites 07b68980760c5d579dd5bbd93dd1ce82eea9339c, whose merge patch includes adding Task-input; the direct source-history commit 44bbbeab3da7a86eda948efbd6b828810f0df356 added the entry and 5332f9746e46c8aff1adb8fd222009da0f4cfc55 cleaned it up.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-28480 had already supplied the Task-output search parameter for the output side of the same include use case. A 2021 questionnaire Zulip thread records the R4-era implementer need and Lloyd McKenzie's note that standard Task.input/Task.output search parameters were planned. FHIR-56061 is a later Waiting for Input issue about CI target inference for these open value[x] reference expressions, but it is unresolved and does not alter the applied decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source has Task-input with code input, type reference, and expression Task.input.value.ofType(Reference), and it also has Task-output with expression Task.output.value.ofType(Reference).
